slides.title: Tum Paris mein ho. Tum India ho.
slides.body: Eiffel Tower ki line, 2 ghante lambi. Bunty ka dimaag: "Jugaad lagate hain."

slides.title: Pehla foreign trip.
slides.body:
Bunty aur Pinky, Paris mein. Ticket ki line kabhi khatam hi nahi ho rahi.
Bunty: "Aage koi dhyaan nahi dega yaar."

slides.title: Aur Bunty aage ghus gaya.
slides.body: Ek buzurg couple ke theek saamne. Phone mein dekhne ka natak.

slides.title: Guard ne seedha peeche bheja.
slides.body: Aur line mein khade Indian students ne mooh chhupa liya.

slides.title: "Yahan tumhara naam koi nahi jaanta."
slides.body: Pinky: "Bas ek cheez jaante hain: tum Indian ho. Aaj unka 'India' tum the."

slides.title: 1.8 crore Indians videsh mein rehte hain.
slides.body: Duniya ka sabse bada diaspora. Aur har saal crore-on log ghoomne jaate hain. Har ek, desh ka chalta-phirta review.
slides.small: Source: UN DESA, International Migrant Stock 2020

slides.title: Mumbai ka bus stop dekho.
slides.body: BEST bus ki line mein log khud se line banate hain, koi guard nahi. Line India mein bhi chalti hai. Jo Mumbai mein karte ho, wahi Paris mein karo.

slides.title: Passport pe India likha hai.
slides.body:
Har harkat desh ka review hai.
Ghar pe bhi, bahar bhi.
Line mein lago, peeche se.

slides.title: Wapas line ke end mein.
slides.body: Aur jab wahi buzurg couple aaye, Bunty ne bola: "After you."

lines: Us dost ko bhejo jo trip pe bhi jugaad lagata hai.
